title: RESIDE OTS targeted geometric source resolution
rationale: The full 542-query route found 39 new bidirectional mappings and exposed three uncounted relationships. Two are high-confidence mutual matches to OTS IDs already present in the parent exclusion union: Haze4K test 69 to OTS 0354 and Haze4K train 977 to OTS 1964. The remaining Haze4K train 937 query has pHash distance zero and correlation 0.999979 to OTS 0230 but a near-tied global-correlation competitor. This orthogonal route uses a frozen RootSIFT and RANSAC geometry test only on these targets, fixed controls, and a bounded candidate shortlist. It resolves source relationships first and deduplicates OTS IDs second; it does not require every relationship to contribute a new ID.

orthogonal_changes.reason: The failed parent used global multi-view correlation and a new-unique-ID gate; this route uses independent local-feature geometry and resolves source relationships before deduplicating exclusion IDs.

scientific_contract.question: Do frozen local-feature and RANSAC geometry checks resolve Haze4K test 69, Haze4K train 977, and Haze4K train 937 to OTS source identities, while positive and negative controls separate and the deduplicated exclusion union preserves at least 6,000 OTS scenes?

intervention.reference: 39 parent-verified new relationships plus three uncounted target relationships, with parent mapping and exclusion identities byte-bound
intervention.matched_budget: three fixed positive pairs, three fixed cross-pair negatives, two fixed target pairs, and the top eight frozen global-retrieval candidates for Haze4K train 937
fixed_factors: RootSIFT descriptors from OpenCV SIFT with nfeatures 8000, contrast threshold 0.01, edge threshold 10, sigma 1.6
bidirectional Lowe ratio 0.75 and reciprocal correspondence intersection
RANSAC homography reprojection threshold 4 pixels, confidence 0.995, and 5,000 iterations
acceptance requires at least 20 reciprocal correspondences, at least 15 homography inliers, and inlier ratio at least 0.35
Haze4K train 937 shortlist is the fixed top eight within the prior top-64 pHash retrieval ordered by global multi-view correlation
all accepted train-937 candidates are conservatively treated as the same verified source family and excluded
no threshold, candidate-count, or control adaptation after target results

primary_estimand.metric: 39 parent-verified relationships plus the number of the three target Haze4K source relationships accepted by the frozen geometric rule
primary_estimand.aggregation: deterministic relationship count followed by OTS-ID set deduplication

controls: positive pairs Haze4K train 101 to OTS 0870, Haze4K train 133 to OTS 7267, and Haze4K test 417 to OTS 6360
negative cross-pairs train 101 to OTS 7267, train 133 to OTS 6360, and test 417 to OTS 0870
parent terminal, summary, mapping, and 959-ID provisional exclusion asset are exact SHA-256-bound inputs
Haze4K test 69 to OTS 0354 and train 977 to OTS 1964 retain their parent global-match diagnostics but must independently pass geometry
a geometry FAIL is a method limitation, not proof that an underlying source relationship is absent

uncertainty.method: deterministic targeted identity audit with exact relationship and exclusion-set counts; no nested keypoint or match is treated as an independent scientific sample

gates.estimand: parent terminal, summary, mapping, and exclusion identities and counts match
qualified RESIDE identity and frozen Haze4K and OTS file counts match
accepted proportion among three fixed positive source pairs
rejected proportion among three fixed negative cross-pairs
Haze4K test 69 to OTS 0354 passes the frozen geometric rule
Haze4K train 977 to OTS 1964 passes the frozen geometric rule
at least one of the frozen top-eight Haze4K train 937 candidates passes the geometric rule and OTS 0230 is present in the shortlist
resolved expected Haze4K outdoor source relationships
OTS clear scenes remaining after deduplicated verified exclusions

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: Global correlation near-ties can arise from duplicate or near-duplicate OTS members of the same source family. Local geometry can verify the family relationship without identifying one privileged filename; multiple accepted members must therefore all be excluded. Failure means only that this frozen geometric method did not resolve a target.
disabled_actions: training, inference, dehazing evaluation, or outcome metric computation
treating keypoints or local matches as independent scientific samples
requiring three target relationships to yield three previously unseen OTS IDs
adapting shortlist size, feature settings, thresholds, controls, or gates after results
claiming mapping infeasibility from a geometric FAIL
executing outdoor measurement before a PASS closeout

precision_contract.rationale: This is a deterministic census of the three remaining target relationships with fixed controls; the certificate records all three independent target groups as required and available.

capability.production_path_statement: The CPU contract exercises the exact RootSIFT, reciprocal-ratio correspondence, RANSAC homography, and acceptance implementation on transformed and unrelated synthetic images, plus the exact 8,970-candidate shortlist path without reading scientific data.

precision.estimand: resolution of the three remaining Haze4K-to-OTS source relationships
precision.source_reference: All three relationships identified by the parent diagnostic are included; no sample estimate is substituted for the exact gate.
